comments.body: Deferring: the affected code path is being replaced next quarter.

content.text: Deferring: the affected code path is being replaced next quarter.
Steps to reproduce: open pagination cursor with a workspace that has more than one member.
Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
